caption:
Open-ended journal prompts give your brain permission to spiral on paper. "How do I feel" gives your brain nowhere to land. The Closed Question is from the free 7-Day Overthinking Detox — DM "JOURNAL" to get it. Save this for tonight. Send it to the friend who journals and still can't sleep.

#journaling #overthinking #anxiety #mentalhealth #arajournals
hook: "just write how you feel" is the worst journaling advice
